extracted.name: Marinated Mozzarella Balls
extracted.description: These marinated mozzarella balls are an easy, make-ahead appetizer for parties and gatherings. Olive oil, lemon, garlic, and herbs fill them with rich flavor.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley and/or basil leaves
⅔ cup extra-virgin olive oil (or enough to cover the mozzarella balls)
8 ounces ciliegine fresh mozzarella cheese balls (drained and patted dry)
instruction_lines: In a medium jar, stir together the herbs, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and ⅓ cup of the olive oil.
Add the mozzarella and top with the remaining ⅓ cup olive oil, adding more as needed to cover the mozzarella.
Cover and refrigerate for at least an hour before serving. Store in the refrigerator for up to 5 days.
